Deployed with Confidence by Acceron. Home 9 Products 9 Nexus ABOUT NEXUS What is Access and Identity Management (AIM)? Access and Identity Management (AIM) is the overarching strategy of processes, policies, and technologies that verify the right users access the right resources at the right time, in a secure manner. With cloud computing, hybrid environments, and remote working becoming the new order, an effective identity and access management (IAM) system is essential to secure sensitive information, manage access, and maintain compliance. Acceron, as an approved Nexus distributor, provides reliable identity and access management solutions to Indian enterprises, combining Nexus Smart ID into comprehensive digital identities. Contact Us ABOUT NEXUS Why Nexus Is a Leader in Access & Identity Management Nexus is at the forefront of enterprise identity access management, offering secure, scalable, and compliant IAM solutions that: Make public key infrastructure (PKI) services easy. Offer smooth single sign-on (SSO) experiences. Improve security with multi-factor authentication (MFA). Integrate cloud, hybrid, and legacy systems. With Nexus authentication, businesses can minimize identity threats, streamline user experiences, and comply with regulations like GDPR and eIDAS.
